info.name: Missing Content-Security-Policy Header
info.description: The Content-Security-Policy header is not set on the response, which could allow certain client-side attacks like XSS.

info.name: Missing X-Frame-Options Header
info.description: The X-Frame-Options header is not set, which may allow the page to be framed by other sites (clickjacking risk).

info.name: Missing X-Content-Type-Options Header
info.description: The X-Content-Type-Options header is not set, which may cause the browser to MIME-sniff the response content.

info.name: Directory Listing Detected
info.description: A directory listing was found, exposing the file structure of the web server.

info.name: Exposed Administration Panel
info.description: An administration panel was found accessible without authentication at /admin/login.php.

info.name: Sensitive Backup File Found
info.description: A backup file (index.php.bak) was found in the web root, potentially exposing source code.

info.name: Outdated jQuery Version - Known Vulnerable Component
info.description: jQuery version 1.8.3 detected, affected by CVE-2020-11022 (XSS in jQuery).

info.name: Generic Reflected Cross Site Scripting
info.description: Reflected XSS was detected via the 'searchFor' parameter on /listproducts.php.

info.name: SQL Injection - Error Based
info.description: SQL injection detected on 'cat' parameter of /listproducts.php via error-based technique.

info.name: Open Redirect Found
info.description: An open redirect was found on /redirect.php allowing arbitrary URL redirection.
